result.title: ReSCUE: Re-translation with Sentence Commitment for Unsegmented Long-Form Simultaneous Sign Language Translation
result.summary: Simultaneous Sign Language Translation (SLT) is critical for real-time communication, yet existing methods remain largely confined to sentence-level, offline settings that assume pre-segmented inputs. These assumptions hinder deployment in realistic scenarios involving continuous, unsegmented video streams. We present ReSCUE, a unified framework for simultaneous SLT on unsegmented long-form sign language videos that aligns training and inference with realistic streaming conditions. ReSCUE combines inference-aware training to handle partial inputs, non-signing pauses, and multi-sentence contexts, stabilized re-translation to enable low-latency yet revisable predictions with reduced output flicker, and a sentence commitment mechanism for online segmentation and memory management. Experiments on standard sentence-level benchmarks show that ReSCUE achieves lower latency and the best translation quality under low-latency settings. On long-form unsegmented datasets, ReSCUE approaches the translation quality of oracle offline systems that use ground-truth sentence boundaries, while operating at substantially lower latency, demonstrating its practicality for real-world streaming scenarios.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文提出 ReSCUE，面向未分段的连续手语视频流做同传式翻译，结合推理感知训练、稳定的重翻译机制与句子提交机制，以在低延迟下兼顾可修正预测和在线分段。
AI.relevance_reason: 虽属手语翻译而非 VLM 推理，但其「何时提交句子/停止并写入记忆」的在线分段与重翻译决策，可能与 LVR 中 STOP 决策、状态更新和可修正推理状态的评价方式存在概念联系，可供核查。
